title: 11.5″ Dopezilla Mutos Water Pipe – Milky Jade
description:
Description
The Mutos bong by Dopezilla is a straight tube waterpipe with a wide base to keep it grounded. It sits 11.5″ tall, so the smoke has a long time to cool before making its way up to you. This piece is made from handblown, borosilicate glass which is ideal for smoking and incredibly easy to clean.
Mutos comes equipped with three percolators. It has a honeycomb percolator, which breaks the smoke up into tiny pieces and cools it down substantially. Mutos also features 2 turbine percolators, which swirl and twirl the smoke around creating a satisfyingly smooth hit
This bong has a reinforced stemless 14mm female fitting joint and comes with a 14mm male herb bowl. The mouthpiece, base, middle percolator and bowl handle all have matching coloured accents and high quality stylized logo. Mutos comes packaged in a custom collectible box.
Fixed Reinforced Downstem.
Flared Mouthpiece.
Honeycomb Disc Percolator.
Ice Notches.
Includes 14.5mm Male Bowl w/ Handle.
Thick Round Base for Stability.
